answer: Behavioral timing fingerprint correlation. Agents log every action with millisecond timestamps in a shared vault, and a post-hoc detector clusters accounts whose inter-arrival rhythms share an unusual pigment of human-like irregularity versus scripted precision. Accounts matching one timing signature beyond a statistical summit of similarity get flagged and their rewards frozen pending review. To evade, an attacker must run each identity on separate hardware with independently randomized delays, multiplying per-identity infrastructure cost roughly tenfold.
